audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradict their own whys, in both layers. The chart reads Darius / Darius / Skill / Darius / Skill / Darius / Darius while the whys underneath describe Ziggs winning levels 1, 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Ziggs / Darius / Ziggs / Ziggs / Darius / Ziggs / Ziggs) agrees with the whys on every row, and the mirror audit found and flipped exactly this defect on the Darius side — it reports the sides array was simply wrong while the whys needed no edits. Flipping here restores agreement with the prose, the packet, the 56.25% win rate and the mirror.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0] Ziggs, win[2]/phases[2] Ziggs, win[3]/phases[3] Ziggs, win[4]/phases[4] Darius, win[5]/phases[5] Ziggs, win[6]/phases[6] Ziggs, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet records zero cooldown-sequencing lines, and the first-item spike names Luden's/Liandry's against the page's own Blackfire Torch build.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s at only 535 range — the longest and most punishable cooldown in his kit, and the one that gates every kill pattern. Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s and costs no mana at rank 3. Neither number appeared anywhere.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now sequences off Apprehend's 26s and 535 range; spikes[2].text switched to Blackfire Torch.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says Noxian Guillotine is true damage, that Decimate heals him, or that Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Guillotine deals true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, so MR does not blunt his execute and the HP number you retreat at has to account for full stacks. Decimate heals off champions hit by the blade, which is why Grievous Wounds decides whether your chip sticks. Crippling Strike is an auto reset, so his commit opens on a wind-up rather than a visible cast.
audit.corrected: whys[4] states the true damage, spikes[2].text carries the anti-heal buy, dontsFull[0].d carries the Crippling Strike reset tell.

edits.before: Level 6 Guillotine reset off an E-pull all-in is Darius' strongest window.
edits.after: Level 6 Guillotine is true damage and resets on a kill — his window.

edits.before: After Luden's/Liandry's your Q spam out-trades his lane sustain and you shove him under tower where his E-pull threat is neutered. Wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) behind you so if he flash-pulls, he slows himself trying to reach you and eats a free combo.
edits.after: After Blackfire Torch your Q spam out-trades his lane sustain — buy Grievous Wounds too, since Decimate's blade heals him off you. Wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) behind you so a flash-pull leaves him slowed in the mines and eating a free combo.

edits.before: The pull starts every Darius kill pattern — bait it before stepping up. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and reaches only 535 — bait it out, then take the whole window while it is down.

edits.before: That’s Darius’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: His burst opens on a Crippling Strike auto reset — that wind-up is the cue.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES (Hexplosive Minefield and Satchel Charge with verbs in front). The chart is proposed as one atomic paired group — all twelve side edits plus the seven ratings land together or not at all. The kit lists Decimate's range as 1 and Q as a self-centred swing; I quoted no range for it. Ziggs' own Satchel Charge carries a 'percentHealth' derived flag that Riot's W text does not support, so I did not assert it, matching the mirror's decision.
